alt_title: Maharashtra and Gujarat: Similar Cotton Crop, Very Different Area
description: In 2024-25 Maharashtra had 36% of India's cotton area but 25% of the cotton crop. Per hectare, that is about two-thirds of India's average.
Gujarat, with 21% of the area, had a similar share of the crop (24%). Gujarat's crop share was higher than Maharashtra's in 2022-23 and 2023-24.
State totals, not per person. Crop in bales of 170 kg. The table shows how much, not why.
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare (2024-25 final estimates), as published in the RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Tables 77 and 64.
